description: Output schema for /hakkutsu invocations. A shard is a single humming signal the substrate detected across the accumulated grounding-envelope. Operator-intuition-recognizable. The substrate observes, never declares. See patterns/hakkutsu-as-divining-rod.md for doctrine. 3-5 shards per invocation (pullthread-digestibility).

shard_name.description: Short kebab-case slug · operator-rememberable · used with --thread and --shrine flags

confidence.description: Substrate-derived from cluster cohesion + size + cycle-distance + operator-recent-attention (negative-weighted)

whisper.description: One-line observational signal. MUST be observational, never prescriptive (the substrate names the WHAT, never the SHOULD). Anti-pattern: declarations replacing operator intuition.

pull.description: Next command the operator could run to dig deeper. Without a pull, hakkutsu becomes a feed; with a pull, it becomes a dialogue.

lens.description: Which legendary-studio lens hakkutsu was pointed at when this shard emerged

shrined_at.description: If operator left a honey-offering (--shrine flag), when. Bookmark for next /hakkutsu pass.

metadata.description: Open metadata · used for shard provenance, cluster diagnostics, etc.
